sources.title: La Table de Maxime — official
sources.claim: La Table de Maxime hotel has 6 rooms above the restaurant; comfort double €240, superior double €260, breakfast included, address Our 23, 6852 Our.

sources.title: La Fabrique du Pré Maho — official
sources.claim: Passive-house timber-on-stilts annex 200 m from the restaurant.

sources.title: Les Jardins de Maxime — official
sources.claim: 4 rooms in the hamlet of Beth, 1.5 km from the restaurant.

sources.title: La Roche des Lutons — official
sources.claim: 65 m² suite-studio with kitchenette and rock-built terrace.

sources.title: L'Avenir — Rouard family takes over
sources.claim: Collard transferred Les Terrasses de l'Our to the Rouard family on 3 October 2024.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — La Table de Maxime
sources.claim: La Table de Maxime holds two Michelin stars in the 2026 Belgium guide.

sources.title: L'Avenir — Michelin 2026 retains 2 stars
sources.claim: Michelin 2026: La Table de Maxime retains its 2 stars.

sources.title: Le Moulin de Daverdisse — official
sources.claim: 4-star hotel in a former watermill with 24 rooms, indoor pool, sauna and hammam, ~11 km from Our.

sources.title: Hotel Le Fournil — official
sources.claim: 11 rooms in the book village of Redu, Nespresso, EV charging, from ~€102.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Auberge la Hutte Lurette
sources.claim: 3-star inn in Paliseul with 12 rooms, restaurant, average rate ~$148.

sources.title: Le Maissin 1876 — official
sources.claim: 5/5-rated B&B in Maissin with bistro, themed rooms.

sources.title: Le Gastronome — official
sources.claim: 8 rooms in Paliseul village; dinner-and-stay packages from €290 for two.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Paliseul hotel rankings
sources.claim: La Table de Maxime ranked #1 Best Value among Paliseul hotels (4.6/5).

sources.title: Maxime Collard — portfolio
sources.claim: Collard operates four lodgings around Our.
